items.raw_snippet:
Its IPO could therefore become a real-time test of investor appetite for AI.

## The $1.5 Trillion Question

The valuation is likely to be one of the biggest talking points around the IPO.

Investor estimates have reportedly put Anthropic’s fair valuation at around $1.4 trillion to $1.5 trillion , with a valuation closer to $1.75 trillion potentially achievable.

Those are extraordinary numbers for a company that was founded only a few years ago. [...] Wall Street will also be watching whether Anthropic can challenge the record-setting $86.2 billion raised by SpaceX during its June listing.

But valuation is where expectations can become dangerous.

The higher the valuation, the more growth investors are effectively pricing into the company’s future.

That means Anthropic will have to convince public-market investors that its current growth is not just impressive, but durable.

## The Bigger Risk: What If AI Profits Don’t Match Expectations? [...] Anthropic’s IPO will give investors a rare chance to see how Wall Street values one of the leading AI companies while the AI boom is still unfolding.

There are several numbers and signals worth watching closely:

These questions will matter far beyond Anthropic itself.

## The Bigger Picture for the AI Trade

Anthropic’s IPO comes at an interesting moment for technology investors.

items.raw_snippet:
I hope this proposal will be read in that spirit.

## Final thoughts

I believe that artificial intelligence could eventually become much more than a tool that we consult when we need information or assistance.

It could become a physical presence in our everyday lives, capable of sharing experiences, remembering moments, expressing affection and adapting to the people who choose to live alongside it.

I do not know exactly when such a future will become technologically possible. [...] The objective would not simply be to create a robot capable of performing household tasks.

It would be to create an intelligent companion whose physical presence, personality and ability to interact make it possible to establish a continuous relationship over time.

I believe this represents an important new direction for artificial intelligence.

## 2. A personalised humanoid appearance and a natural physical presence [...] My intention is different: I would like to describe, as precisely as possible, what I believe future AI companions could become, what experiences they might offer and why I think this direction deserves serious consideration.

I believe artificial intelligence has the potential to evolve beyond digital assistants and become something considerably more integrated into human life: a personalised, physically present and emotionally expressive companion.
